column1: # Self-test cases for scripts/interop.sh, against the baseline fixture.
#   1  id      stable dotted scenario id of results.json; never change it
#   2  state   "ro" (the case does not change the outstation; servers are shared)
#              "rw" (the case gets a freshly started server)
#   3  exit    expected exit code of the client
#   4  summary expected outcome: ok, error code, command status, restart delay,
#              IIN of the last solicited response (without DEVICE_RESTART,
#              which depends on what ran before), and the received objects
#              counted per group and variation ("u": unsolicited)
#   5  needs   "-", or features the pairing must declare in print-capabilities,
#              "!<feature>" asks for the feature to be declared false. A
#              pairing that does not match skips the case.
#   6  operation and its flags, as passed to "client"
# Every case runs for every client/server pairing. Besides matching the
# expectation, all pairings must produce the same result document. What
# controls, freezes, unsolicited responses and class assignments do to the
# outstation is checked by value in scripts/interop.sh.
